ItemID: NA; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Familiar melodic rock fits my recent classic-rock and greatest-hits listening; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Toby Keith 35 Biggest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for older pop, folk, and classic rock right now; this country collection is less appealing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Unchained Melody: Very Best Of The Righteous Brothers; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The vocal harmonies and mid-sixties sound fit my interest in Simon & Garfunkel and AM Gold; I would try this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sounds of Summer: Very Best of The Beach Boys; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Melodic sixties pop and rich harmonies fit my Beatles and mid-sixties listening; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Complete Hit Singles; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection matches what I want to hear.
ItemID: NA; Title: Photographs & Memories: His Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Jim Croce's acoustic storytelling fits my Jonathan Edwards and Simon & Garfunkel listening; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Platinum Collection: Greatest Hits I, II & III; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Queen fits my classic-rock interest, but I would pass this time because I am leaning toward gentler songs.
ItemID: NA; Title: All Over the World - The Very Best of Electric Light Orchestra; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic pop-rock fits my Beatles and Cars listening, but other collections appeal more today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Peter, Paul and Mary; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Folk songs and close harmonies strongly fit my Melanie and Simon & Garfunkel listening; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Journey Greatest Hits       explicit_lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my broader classic-rock interest, but arena-rock anthems are less appealing than folk and sixties pop today.
